hook: The prophets fasted for a birth they would never live to see.

verse.translation: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

story: The church teaches that after the fall, God gave Adam a promise: when five thousand five hundred years are complete, I will be born from your descendants and save you.
The prophets believed that promise. In every generation they longed for the day of salvation, and they fasted and prayed for it, even though none of them lived to see it.
That's where the name comes from: Tsome Nebiyat, the Fast of the Prophets. Because the promise to Adam was fulfilled at the end of it, it's also called Tsome Adam.
meaning: The prophets fasted waiting for Christ to come. We keep the same fast remembering that He came, and the church teaches it brings blessing to body and soul.

sources.title: ጾመ ነቢያት: አስተምህሮ፣ ስብከት፣ ብርሃንና ኖላዊ (Astemhro, church teaching on the Fast of the Prophets)
ጾመ ነቢያት, Memhir Samson Worku (Mahibere Kidusan)

review.notes: The 5,500-year promise comes from church tradition, not from Genesis. Check the wording with Memhir Senay.
